title: Shared prefixes remove duplicate blocks
hook: Shared prefixes remove duplicate blocks. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Count distinct substrings from suffix lengths minus neighbouring longest-common-prefix lengths.

misconception: Every suffix contributes all its prefixes as new substrings.
objective: Count distinct substrings from suffix lengths minus neighbouring longest-common-prefix lengths.

claims.text: Each sorted suffix contributes its length minus the prefix shared with its preceding neighbour. Those overlap deductions remove repeated substrings while retaining each distinct substring once.
